description: Use this to rename a category, change its emoji or move it. expectedRevision is the category's lockVersion from get_group.

emoji.description: A new emoji for the category.

expectedRevision.description: The `lockVersion` the client last saw on the record it is changing. A mismatch is `409 CONFLICT` with the record as the server now has it.

position.description:
Its place in the category list, 1 first. Only this category's number
changes: categories on the same number keep the order they were added in.

name: update_category
title: Edit a category
